name: Admin Project Lifecycle Transitions
description: From a project row, an admin changes the real lifecycle state only through a two-step preview/apply dialog. The preview explains billing, reminder, hosting and debt consequences before confirmation. Suspension is reversible and preserves caused debt while stopping new automatic billing; completion means a clean close; decommission is definitive, requires an explicit keep/write-off decision for every caused receivable, and a direct jump that did not pass through Suspended requires a note. A stale financial preview fails closed and remains open. The same row exposes the immutable dated episode history, including actor and note, and a failed-hosting signal only suggests suspension — it never applies it automatically.
